hot.title: "0.27% reply rate on AI-written first lines."
hot.meta: Jake · LinkedIn text post · Mon Nov 9, 04:00 ET
why: It's the most-engaged post on LinkedIn, the platform that brought 56 of the 61 organic leads: 16 engagements (9 likes, 7 comments) on 332 impressions, a 4.8% engagement rate.
The hook opens on a hard number from our own data (0.27% vs 14.5%), the same pattern as the next two best LinkedIn posts (7% connect rate; 31,000 inboxes).
It's about cold outreach dying. That was the #1 pain in 8 of 9 Scope buyers' strategy calls.

tests: Add a per-post tracked link (Hyros or UTM content = post slug) to Jake's LinkedIn posts and profile link. Right now 56 leads say only "linkedin.com", so no post can be credited.
Make the LinkedIn mix about 80% text
Text posts had a median of 160 impressions and 106 comments. Videos had a median of 64 and 10 comments. Turn the weekly own-data number into the standard post.
Fix the Instagram CTA, or stop counting Instagram for leads
107 reels with "Comment REPORT" got 31k views, 4 comments and 0 report leads. Test a bio link with a UTM plus a DM keyword on 3 reels, and judge it on report leads.
230 posts, 440k views, 52 engagements, 0 leads. Keep it automated, but leave it out of lead decisions and don't spend production time on it.
Turn the cold-outreach-is-dead angle into an ad
Use the 0.27% / 31,000-inboxes angle as a deadcold variant. It's the pain behind the most-engaged posts and 8 of 9 Scope buyers.
